preconditions.description: The number of main courses k and total courses n satisfy 1 <= k <= n <= 10^5.

preconditions.expression: len(main_courses) == k and all(1 <= x <= n for x in main_courses) and len(set(main_courses)) == k
preconditions.description: The list of main courses contains exactly k distinct integers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(dependencies) == n and all(0 <= t <= n-1 for t in [len(d) for d in dependencies]) and all(all(1 <= x <= n and x != i+1 for x in d) for i, d in enumerate(dependencies))
preconditions.description: There are n dependency lists; each list contains distinct integers from 1 to n excluding the course itself.
The sum of all dependency counts does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: is_impossible or (len(result_lines) == 2 and result_lines[0].strip() == str(len(result_courses)) and len(result_courses) == int(result_lines[0].strip()) and all(1 <= x <= n for x in result_courses) and len(set(result_courses)) == len(result_courses))
postconditions.description: If impossible, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output has two lines: the count m and m distinct course IDs.

postconditions.expression: is_impossible or (all(x in result_courses for x in main_courses))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output sequence must include all main courses.

postconditions.expression: is_impossible or (all(all(dep in result_courses and result_courses.index(dep) < result_courses.index(course) for dep in dependencies[course-1]) for course in result_courses))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, for every course in the output, all its dependencies must appear earlier in the sequence.

postconditions.expression: is_impossible or (all(all(dep in result_courses for dep in dependencies[course-1]) for course in result_courses))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the set of courses in the output is closed under dependencies (all required prerequisites are included).

postconditions.expression: is_impossible or (len(result_courses) == len(set(c for c in range(1, n+1) if any(c in main_courses or any(c in dependencies[x-1] for x in range(1, n+1) if x in result_courses or any(x in dependencies[y-1] for y in range(1, n+1) if y in result_courses)))))
postconditions.description: The output sequence contains exactly the minimal set of courses required: all main courses and all their transitive dependencies, and no others.

postconditions.expression: not is_impossible or (any(all(dep in result_courses for dep in dependencies[course-1]) for course in range(1, n+1) if course in main_courses) == False)
postconditions.description: If output is -1, it is impossible to satisfy dependencies for at least one main course (cycle or missing path).
